newsitem.title: USA: First Union Keystone to redeem Keystone debt.
newsitem.headline: First Union Keystone to redeem Keystone debt.

text.p: First Union Keystone Inc said on Friday it placed money with a trustee to free itself from restrictions on some senior secured notes.
The company said it chose to effect covenant defeasance in accordance with terms of the indenture relating to $145 million of principal amount of its 9.75 percent senior secured notes due 2003.

In connection with this action, First Union said it would redeem all of outstanding notes on Sept. 2, 1998, at a redemption price equal to 103.375 percent of their principal amount plus any accrued and unpaid interest to such date.
It said it deposited sufficient cash and securities with a trustee, to redeem these notes on Sept. 2, 1998, the earliest date the notes could be redeemed under the indenture terms.

First Union Keystone Inc is the successor to Keystone Investments Inc, formerly Keystone Group Inc, which originally issued the notes. Keystone Investments, the investment adviser to the Keystone family of mutual funds, was acquired by First Union Corp on December 11.
